t: 3-conductor, lever splicing reusable connector. Suitable for solid, stranded and fine-stranded conductors from 0.2 to 4 mm² and fine-stranded 0.14 to 4 mm² (24–12 AWG). Slim design saves space in tight areas. Features lever and spring pressure technology to facilitate universal conductor connections without special tools. Suitable for junction boxes: Wagobox 207-3301, 207-3304 and 207-4301. 32A rating for UK and Europe. 20A rating for Japan.
b: Saves Time for Installers & Device Manufacturers
